title: Don't generate bridge methods for inaccessible Java package-private methods

target.summary: The accessibility check suppresses bridge method generation for Scala package-private (private[pkg]) methods extended from another package, even though they are emitted as public at the JVM level. This causes a runtime AbstractMethodError when calling covariant overrides across compilation boundaries.
notes: faulty accessibility check suppressing bridge methods for Scala private[pkg] methods instead of only Java package-private methods
